    • attachTo

      public void attachTo(com.badlogic.gdx.physics.box2d.Body anchorBody, com.badlogic.gdx.math.Vector2 point)
      Queues a rope attachment. Called by the arrow when it lands, which happens mid physics step, so the joint itself is built on the next update.
      Parameters:
      anchorBody - the body that was hit
      point - where the arrow struck, in world coordinates
